mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy cycle, which reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate above 4.0% triggers a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return as elevated joblessness signals weak labor demand and reduced consumer confidence, dampening equity valuations.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain positive despite UNRATE crossing above 4.0%, or the trigger occurs but returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in personal consumption (GDPC1) and decline in housing starts (HOUST) indicates shifting demand toward non-housing sectors, amplifying growth signals and driving positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: The interaction effect does not predict returns better than individual proxies, or returns are negative despite the combined signal over 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 signals supply-side contraction, reducing corporate investment and consumer spending, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain positive despite INDPRO falling below 100.0, or the drop does not precede returns by at least 10 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), persistent increases in the federal funds rate reduce growth expectations, generating negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns as investors anticipate higher inflation and slower economic expansion.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive despite FEDFUNDS rising above 5.0% in the tightening regime, or the tightening signal does not precede returns by the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A convergence of falling unemployment (UNRATE) and rising payrolls (PAYEMS) strengthens labor market confidence, boosting equity valuations and driving positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: The interaction effect does not predict returns better than individual proxies, or returns are negative despite the combined signal over 5 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in personal consumption (GDPC1) above 2% growth rates signals robust demand, compressing discount rates and driving positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) despite GDPC1 growth exceeding 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 110.0 indicates supply-side expansion, stimulating corporate investment and consumer spending, which drives positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns remain negative despite INDPRO rising above 110.0, or the increase does not precede returns by the horizon.
